checked_obligation: Conditionally on the Case 1 assumption that the total list sum T is at most 210, prove that selecting the entire list gives 200 ≤ T ≤ 210 and hence a valid sum for N=10.
reason: The game condition gives T ≥ 200, while the case assumption gives T ≤ 210. Thus 200 ≤ T ≤ 210, and selecting the entire list is permitted. Since [200,210] is contained in [190,210]=[200-10,200+10], this selection wins for N=10 in this case. None of the listed external rules is relevant.
